title: Total work of conditional steps
statement: Let a finite-domain constraint satisfaction problem have a nonempty multiset of constraints, with every declared variable occurring in some constraint scope. Suppose the domain is finite and nonempty and the variable set has decidable equality. Running the local conditional steps through any list from an initial state increases the work by the sum of the step-work costs for the variables in that list.
hypotheses_covered: The domain is finite and nonempty
The variable set has decidable equality
Every declared variable occurs in a constraint scope
A list of variables and an initial state
